newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones slipped by 25.34 points to 6,036.46. PLDT's ADR rose by $0 3/8 to $60 1/4.
* The peso closed at 26.28 to a U.S.dollar from 26.276.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,049.59, down 23.53.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 11.09375 percent from 11.3125.
* Members of the Philippine Stock Exchange vote in favour of key reforms which will give the bourse the status of a self-regulating organisation.
* Four local companies, Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc, Ayala Land Inc, Benpres Holdings Corp, and Metro Pacific Corp, have been prequalified to bid for the privatisation of the Manila water utility.
* Greater Asia Resources Corp is planning to take over the development of a 450-hectare beachfront property in Aklan, near the Boracay resort island.
* Stockbrokers have criticised a new scheme for distributing initial public offerings saying it is a step backward from market reforms.
* Philippine National Bank is expected to release its third quarter figures this morning.
* BPI Capital Corp recommends a cautious buy in the market since it still expected the stock index to go down further.
